signal: Corcentric expanded its procurement ecosystem in February 2026 through a partnership with Unite's European marketplace, extending its source-to-pay reach.

email.body1:
David, saw Corcentric just expanded the procurement ecosystem with Unite's European marketplace.

Opening new buyer reach usually means more in-market accounts in play than the procurement-services team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Corcentric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
David, quick follow-up for Corcentric.

Expanding the ecosystem usually grows the addressable list faster than reps can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the procurement-services book needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
David, last bit of proof for Corcentric.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Corcentric reply rate likely compares to other source-to-pay vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
David, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and standing up new partner reach is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to procurement services? I will tailor it to Corcentric either way.
